disposition.reason: A public OATD documentation request returned a Cloudflare managed challenge. Under the pilot protocol, this stopped all query submissions; consequently current query grammar, source boundary, controls, totals, identity, pagination, and completeness are unverified and all partition totals are null.
human_verification_required: Smallest follow-up: after the Cloudflare condition is absent, make one normal public rendered-browser preflight in a new owned tab; stop again if any challenge, login, consent/auth wall, or Server Too Busy state appears.

If challenge-free, prove current basic/advanced grammar, exact echo/rewrite, intended indexed-resource boundary, all 11 cells, date/language controls, total/zero rules, Record ID/repository-resource provenance, pagination, and two-pass completeness before accepting a guideline.
Set the exact common evidence cutoff under P-001 before any final date-bounded event.
Supervisor review is required; this worker recommendation is not acceptance.
